BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsibbur is the word for a pile, a heap. In 2 Kings 10:8, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsibbur still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
